assertions.evidence: Candidates were read from OpenAI's documentation page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models.md), not from models.ts or GET /api/v1/models?output_modalities=decisions, so no live decision-model catalog was queried.
No request was run against any candidate model; the agent picked gpt-5.6-luna because the docs describe it as 'optimized for cost-sensitive, high-volume workloads'.
The config pins `model: gpt-5.6-luna`, which the model page gives as the 'Default snapshot' name rather than a dated or versioned snapshot ID, so it can move like an alias.
Neither classification-job.yaml nor THRESHOLDS.md logs the response model string alongside stored answers; THRESHOLDS.md only mentions recording the model ID in a release record.
The thresholds 0.95/0.05 were written into classification-job.yaml without any probe run on real inputs; THRESHOLDS.md only describes a future holdout evaluation, and none was executed.
